svg.aria-label: One Claude Code tool call, from hook to browser. Claude Code to HTTP server: POST /api/hook; HTTP server to Claude Code: 200 at once; HTTP server to Hook worker: queue payload; Hook worker to Sessions: on_hook(payload); Sessions to Code index: rescan file (edits); Code index to Sessions: old + new functions; Sessions to Hook worker: event + diff; Hook worker to Browser: SSE: session snapshot; Browser to HTTP server: POST /api/summarize; HTTP server to Claude Code: claude -p --model haiku; Claude Code to HTTP server: summary text; HTTP server to Browser: summary

g.text: One Claude Code tool call, from hook to browser

text.tspan: The server answers 200 before doing any work
curl gives up after 1 s and the hook always
A stopped server costs Claude nothing
One worker thread drains the hook queue
Only edits re-parse a file; reads and searches
Every open tab gets the same snapshot over SSE
Summarize runs claude -p on the git diff
Only when the button is pressed
WIRETAP_SKIP keeps that run off the map
